plugins.name: acp-paypal
plugins.description: Integrate and debug PayPal APIs using the acp-paypal MCP server.

plugins.name: maxio-sdk
plugins.description: Install and consume the Maxio Advanced Billing .NET SDK, grounded in a bundled SDK map. The integrate-maxio workflow skill plans a map-grounded contract sheet before any code is written, implements from it, and fixes SDK compile/build errors map-first — cloning the SDK source only when the map cannot settle a fact. Includes the maxio-getting-started map and the seven dotnet-* companion skills. No MCP server.

plugins.name: paypal-sdk
plugins.description: Install and consume the PayPal .NET SDK, grounded in a bundled SDK map. The integrate-paypal workflow skill plans a map-grounded contract sheet before any code is written, implements from it, and fixes SDK compile/build errors map-first — cloning the SDK source only when the map cannot settle a fact. Includes the paypal-getting-started map and the seven dotnet-* companion skills. No MCP server. (Do not install alongside acp-paypal — the integrate-paypal skill name collides.)
